summary.text: Christal Lloyd is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 8, where she assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works in the nonprofit sector and lives in Nashua.

paragraphs.text: Christal Lloyd lives in Nashua, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of Kansas in 2006.
Her career experience includes working in the nonprofit sector.
Lloyd's 2023-2024 committee assignment was the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
